# ALVStore

> Bespoke private cinema design, native 4K laser projection, architectural acoustics, and reference home theater engineering across India (established 2009, Udaipur studio).

ALVStore designs, supplies, installs, and calibrates bespoke private cinemas across India from its experience room at Shop No. 2, 229, Alok School Road, Sector 11, Hiran Magri, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001 (Mon–Sat, 10:00–20:00 IST; Sunday by appointment). Core partner systems include Sony SXRD & JVC D-ILA native 4K laser projectors (120"–220" woven acoustically transparent screens), Denon AVC, Marantz Cinema & Arcam Class G amplification, and JBL Synthesis, Bowers & Wilkins, KEF Uni-Q & Polk Audio architectural loudspeakers with Dirac Live and Audyssey MultEQ XT32 room calibration.

## Main Pages

- [ALVStore Studio Gallery](https://alvstore.com/): Showcase of curated systems, architectural room engineering, and consultation intake.
- [Contact & Consultation](https://alvstore.com/contact): Phone (+91 98876 01200), email (sales@alvstore.in), Udaipur studio directions, and pan-India site survey booking.

## Architecture & Engineering Notes

- [Curated Hardware Collection](https://alvstore.com/#collection): Reference Denon, Marantz, JBL Synthesis, Arcam, Polk Audio, Bowers & Wilkins, KEF, Sony, and JVC cinema hardware.
- [Interactive Spatial Room Planner](https://alvstore.com/#studio-planner): Live acoustic and geometry planning across 5.1, 5.1.2, 7.2.2, and 7.2.4 Dolby Atmos configurations.
- [Three-Step Engineering Workflow](https://alvstore.com/#process): Room consultation, CAD acoustic drawing, turnkey installation, and on-site Dirac Live calibration.
- [After-Sales & Support](https://alvstore.com/#after-sales): Scheduled Dirac Live re-tuning, projector optical maintenance, HDMI 2.1 eARC diagnostics, and pan-India care.
- [Private Cinema Technical FAQ](https://alvstore.com/#engineering-notes): Room dimension requirements, supported projection/amplification hardware, Dirac Live & ISF calibration, and pan-India execution.
